notes: New component inside existing system: no driver, no direction step. Sheet = project truth (@gorhom/bottom-sheet 5, already used); expo/ui eliminated (not installed, would add a dependency). No range-slider library, so the safe default is building the price range with the installed Gesture Handler + Reanimated 4.7 (New Arch on SDK 58); that is gesture work, so animate-expo. Medium so review step = impeccable audit (native variant). L1 tsc, L2 expo export, L3+L4 via agent-device on iOS simulator; Android behavior (back closes sheet) unverified.

Optimize sub-type (stutters): inspect, measure, fix, re-measure. motion-performance: animate-expo (RN, not Expo-only); use its decisions only and write Reanimated 3 APIs (runOnJS, no worklets). swm/react-native-best-practices eliminated (needs New Arch); emil/animation-performance is web-only. No upgrade. Measure with the perf monitor (JS vs UI thread) in a release build on the physical Android device, so L5 is reachable; agent-device drives the swipe.

Design+build for press feedback. 'Feels dead' asks for exactly the feel judgment animate-expo provides, so it is routed even though the task is Small. Reanimated 4.6 + worklets on New Arch; Gesture Handler v3 hooks API (translate its v2 recipes). No haptics library, and adding one needs permission. Review step: built-in motion checklist for one component; recommend /review-animations. agent-device excluded, so evidence is L1 tsc, L2 assembleDebug and adb screenshots (launch state only). The press state can't be captured and there is no physical device for feel (L5).

Improve sub-type on one flow: audit with the built-in motion checklist (improve-animations is for app-wide or several flows) and recommend /review-animations. Legacy arch (newArchEnabled=false, SDK 52) with Reanimated 3.16, so animate-expo's decisions are translated to Reanimated 3 APIs. swm is eliminated (needs New Arch), and choreograph is web-only. No upgrade. agent-device excluded: simctl screenshots, plus an Expo --web preview labeled not device evidence. No physical device for feel (L5).

The only dimension asked is platform conformance, so dickwu/apple-design (Liquid Glass/HIG authority, App Store pre-submission) in review mode; no ux-critique or code-review. Built with Xcode 27, so the new bars and sheets apply on iOS 26+ with no opt-out. Render on the iOS 27 simulator via agent-device: L0 + L4. No files changed.

Finding UX problems on one screen = ux-critique (impeccable critique: central, so heavy cost doesn't block it; Assessment B skipped on native; no .impeccable/ or PRODUCT.md writes) plus platform-conformance (dickwu/apple-design) on Apple platforms. Render on the simulator via agent-device (checkout needs a cart state): L0 + L4. Read-only.

The core ask is visual verification on iPhone SE and iPad, but there is no Xcode or simulator, so nothing can render (agent-device unavailable: no booted simulator). Only a code-level responsive review (size classes, 320pt width, Dynamic Type) via impeccable audit's native variant is possible, so the status is Needs review. Give the exact xcodebuild/simctl commands for SE and iPad captures. Don't install Xcode.

Taste is eliminated: its house rule forbids violet and conflicts with the brand. Impeccable new-work (marketing page when Taste is unsuitable), as a surface inside the established world: keep violet-600/lavender-100 tokens, Persuade mode. One question batch: product facts (features, pricing, testimonials; meanwhile marked placeholders) and permission for PRODUCT.md. If unanswered, fall back to anthropic/frontend-design. Independent tech-audit by a different evaluator: vercel/web-design-guidelines (network; fallback to impeccable audit in a fresh context). a11y via that review + ui-check. L1 astro check, L2 astro build, L4 ui-check at 390/768/1280 light/dark.

Greenfield app UI with no governing system (only the template Colors), so the driver is impeccable/new-work (owns direction/type/color/layout; fills design-system as Expo theme tokens). Shape runs first for the 3-screen flow (Large). Its PRODUCT.md interview and file-write permission go in one question batch. If unanswered, fall back to uupm/design-system. Motion for the habit check-off feedback = animate-expo. Review by different evaluators: dickwu/apple-design (platform-conformance, new RN screens on Large) and impeccable audit in a fresh context (a11y yes). Navigation: keep Expo Router native tabs, routes added with built-in guidance. No subagents stated, so sequential-review. agent-device excluded: simctl screenshots per route via deep links; interaction and Android unverified.

Two targets: apps/web (Next.js 16) and apps/mobile (Expo 58); the schema allows one platform. Refresh (default, stated): the shared tokens package governs, so no driver and only additive tokens. High risk (large redesign of live onboarding, a critical path, plus shared tokens), so the user confirms the plan first (if unanswered, stop at the plan with Needs review). Then multi-agent with an independent reviewer. audit-current = impeccable critique on both apps (central evidence base). Review = tech-audit with impeccable audit in a fresh context (a11y yes). Motion skills (emil/animate for web, animate-expo for mobile) and polish only if the audit or review finds motion or polish issues. Web L4 via ui-check; mobile via simctl only (agent-device excluded); no L5.

Platform-conformance on Android: dickwu/apple-design is eliminated (Android-only app would get Apple conventions), so impeccable critique in native mode (Android guidance). Large review means code-review, but there is no Compose candidate, so the built-in project lint + android.md §10. Material3 1.4 stable (no Expressive). Check predictive back, edge-to-edge and window size classes against android.md. Render on the emulator via agent-device: L0 + L4. Read-only, single.
